name: Discrete BJT — 8V — SOIC
description: Discrete BJT parts (HFA3046, HFA3046s, HFA3096, HFA3127BZ, HFA3128BZ) in an 8V SOIC cluster, spanning SOIC-14 and SOIC-16 footprints sourced from the Alternate KiCad Library.
selection_hints: Prefer tier A entries with datasheets and exact footprint matches.
Match footprint exactly: SOIC-14_3.9x8.7mm_P1.27mm vs SOIC-16_3.9x9.9mm_P1.27mm.
Check pin-to-pad mapping and package dimensions before committing a PCB.
Use only where a SOIC land pattern is intended.
avoid_when: The required voltage, current, speed or tolerance is not stated by the selected part.
The symbol-footprint pairing is guessed or flagged for review.
The board layout needs a package other than SOIC.
A single discrete transistor footprint is needed rather than a multi-pin SOIC array.
